articles.title: Rock & Roll Hall of Fame's class of 2026 includes Phil Collins, Oasis and Sade
articles.summary: The Rock & Roll Hall of Fame announced its 2026 class of eight inductees, highlighting diverse musical talent. The list includes an R&B legend, a prominent heavy metal band, and a successful drummer-turned-frontman. This annual selection celebrates artists whose significant contributions have profoundly shaped rock and roll music and its cultural landscape.
